summary: Warm paper and an editorial serif, set narrow for reading at length.
for: Prose, handovers, plans and reports someone actually sits down and reads.

display.systemStack: Georgia, "Iowan Old Style", "Times New Roman", serif

body.systemStack: Georgia, "Iowan Old Style", "Times New Roman", serif

voice.proseTone: Write in measured, complete sentences and let the reasoning show. Say why before what where the why is not obvious. Prefer a paragraph to a bullet list when the ideas connect, and reach for a table only when the data really is tabular. Contractions are fine; hedging is not - if something is uncertain, name the uncertainty rather than softening every sentence around it. Assume the reader has time and wants to understand, not to skim.
